easyPrerequisites:
Silent Attendant does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Silent Attendant.
description:
Activate Silent Attendant by tapping it, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's ability by paying {U}, untapping Silent Attendant.
Repeat.
